constraint.description: The name of the Constraint the Policy is configuring, for example, serviceuser.services.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

version.description: Version of the Policy. Default version is 0.

boolean_policy.description: A boolean policy is a constraint that is either enforced or not.

boolean_policy.enforced.description: If true, then the Policy is enforced. If false, then any configuration is acceptable.

list_policy.description: A policy that can define specific values that are allowed or denied for the given constraint. It can also be used to allow or deny all values.

list_policy.inherit_from_parent.description: If set to true, the values from the effective Policy of the parent resource are inherited, meaning the values set in this Policy are added to the values inherited up the hierarchy.

list_policy.suggested_value.description: The Google Cloud Console will try to default to a configuration that matches the value specified in this field.

list_policy.allow.description: One or the other must be set.

list_policy.allow.all.description: The policy allows or denies all values.

list_policy.allow.values.description: The policy can define specific values that are allowed or denied.

list_policy.deny.description: One or the other must be set.

list_policy.deny.all.description: The policy allows or denies all values.

list_policy.deny.values.description: The policy can define specific values that are allowed or denied.

restore_policy.description: A restore policy is a constraint to restore the default policy.

restore_policy.default.description: May only be set to true. If set, then the default Policy is restored.
